close_reason: Superseded by JMAP-7a8b.1 (same issue, idiomatic-rust framing)
description: MdnBackend::send_mdns receives send: HashMap<Id, Mdn> where keys are client creation IDs. In JMAP, client creation IDs are arbitrary strings; Id is the type for server-assigned identifiers (RFC 8620 §3.6). Using Id for creation IDs conflates two distinct namespaces. Idiomatic JMAP Rust: use String (or a newtype CreationId) for client creation IDs. This also affects MdnSendResult. Fix both the trait method signature and MdnSendResult together.
title: send_mdns trait method takes HashMap<Id, Mdn> — Id is wrong type for client creation IDs
